scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "green,cyan" --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm --dir backend run dev" "pnpm --dir frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir backend exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --dir frontend exec tsc --noEmit
